name: wowcsg-fitness
description: WOW-CSG 7 Days Fitness Challenge — Capacitor Android + iOS apps

scripts.cap:sync: npm run copy:www && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:android: npm run copy:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:ios: npm run copy:www && npx cap sync ios
scripts.android: npm run cap:sync:android && npx cap open android
scripts.android:build: npm run cap:sync:android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.ios: npm run cap:sync:ios && npx cap open ios
